title: Research Brief
description: The output of a research inquiry. The required fields are the ones that are otherwise omitted under time pressure: the decision it serves, what could not be established, and a grade on every load-bearing claim.

question.description: Narrowed until a finite search could answer it.

narrowed_away.description: What the scoping deliberately excluded, so the requester can object.

decision.description: The decision this informs. Research without one is a hobby.

required_evidence_grade.description: Set from the decision's consequence BEFORE the search, not after seeing results.

answer.description: The answer first. Reasoning follows it.

confidence.description: The weakest grade among the claims the answer actually rests on.

load_bearing.description: Does the answer collapse if this is wrong?

source_chain.description: Each hop from the citing document back to the origin, so the trace is auditable.

independent_origins.description: Distinct origins, not documents. Twelve outlets citing one release is 1.

unverifiable.description: Set when the chain dead-ended. Better than quietly accepting the claim.

items.description: Preserved, never averaged into a false consensus.

absence_is_informative.description: Did we fail to find it because it is not there, or because we could not look?

not_established.description: At least one entry. A brief claiming to have established everything has not looked hard enough.

searched_and_not_found.description: Absence is a result. Record it so it is not re-searched.

retrieval_tags.description: Question, entity, and decision tags — the repository is only an asset if it is retrievable.
